notes.title: Bug fixes, more achievements and PS port!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We have a small patch fixing some quality-of-life stuff and adding more achievements!

We're also releasing the game on PlayStation today, meaning there will be more players to crossplay with! You can get the PlayStation version here: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10009990


Patch Notes:

 Made it possible to have crossplay with Playstation
 Added options menu to in-game pause menu
 Fixed various localization issues
 Fixed bullets not growing correctly from some card effects
 Fixed issue when players press join at the same time
 Better readability in some menus
 Added option to mute chat

New achievements!

 Accidental Winner: Win 10 rounds by your opponent falling out
 Winner: Win 20 matches
 Frosty: Use Frost Slam 20 times
 Champion: Win 50 Matches
 Demon: Use Demonic Pact 3 times in a single match
 In Control: Use Remote 3 times in a single match
 Teleporter: Use Teleport 3 times in a single match
 Star: Use Supernova 3 times in a single match
 Joker: Lose 0-5
 Radiant: Use Radiance 3 times in a single match
 Phoenix: Use Phoenix
 Shield Up: Trigger a block with Shields Up
 Sharp: Use Saw


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40216596/661fd71d26dd1213b86764fd17288f5598c74ff9.png

Mods
We know a lot of people play ROUNDS with mods and that some mods may not work with this new version, here's how you can still access the mods:

If you want to play ROUNDS with mods we have made the beta branch available for the old pre-Xbox patch version of the game - this seems to be the most compatible version with most major mods. You can access it by: Right-clicking on Rounds in your Steam Library > Properties > Betas > In the drop-down menu, select "Old ROUNDS for mods" for the pre-2023 version of the game or version_1.1.1 for the version before this update.

notes.title: ROUNDS patch: 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Thank you for being patient as we sort out some bugs from the latest update. 

We know some of you are sad about the fan-made mods no longer working since the update - we've spoken with the modding community and they're working to fix their mods. In the meantime please check out the modder-run discord modding server for updates: https://discord.gg/rounds-modding

(We as developers do not moderate this server but we thought it would be good to link it for those of you who are having issues with your mods or that want to know more about mods in general)

Remember that these modders are making mods in their free time and because they love the game, please be patient while they work on fixes. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40216596/839f4dc3d2bfc6b2d75f0780689ebc108f171a3a.png


Patch notes 1.1.1:

 Hide map border in the main menu (Only affects ultra-wide screen)
 Confine cursor to monitor when in exclusive fullscreen
 Wrecking ball and moving platforms now render correctly
 Bullets now correctly scale based on damage from cards
 Don't count EMP for Beekeeper achievement
 Don't allow chat to open with a gamepad 


Remember to verify the integrity of the game files to ensure you're on the right update.

notes.title: Achievement update: Patch 1!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Thank you all for alerting us to the bugs in the last update, we're looking into them all but to start we have a patch to fix some of them. 

If you have more bugs to report or crashes please email us at support@landfall.se with crash logs and as much detail as you can - it helps us figure out what's wrong. 


Patch Notes: 

- Fixed issues with objects blending into the background and other visual issues
- Fixed rematch issues
- Fixed Hypersonic Achievement
- Fixed issue where both sets of cards would spawn in at once
- Fixed the issue where you could no longer press shift to change the map theme
- Fixed issue where the L in "Glass Cannon" was invisible

If you play with a friend on Xbox some of these issues may persist as it takes a while to patch console platforms - but a fix is on the way there too!
